notes: Medium: the agent must locate a single off-by-stride defect in a small C extension, rebuild it as a CPython module, and drive a data-driven harness. Exact 8-hex checksums across empty/single/boundary/duplicate vectors require genuinely repairing the fold loop rather than hardcoding the visible report; hidden inputs (empty vectors, length-2/3 vectors that lay bare which indices are folded, values near the 32-bit ceiling) force generalization. Mixing constants are fixed and documented, so the core reasoning is contained but non-trivial.
